mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% over three consecutive months indicates labor market tightness that pressures firms to raise wages, increasing inflation expectations and prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in tight labor market periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.3 million units per month signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in high housing start periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 over three months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals a contraction in real economic output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO remains below 103.0, or the average return in low-industrial production periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a synchronized housing boom that reflects strong household demand and confidence, driving corporate earnings expectations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPIAUCSL and stable FEDFUNDS signals that inflation is accelerating while monetary policy remains accommodative, increasing real rate uncertainty and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between rising CPIAUCSL and stable FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over the past 7 months, combined with stable housing starts (HOUST), indicates a resilient consumer-driven economy that supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and stable HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
